launches.name: Lucerne Grand
launches.thesis: Lakeside MRT one minute away. A supermarket and shops downstairs. 570 homes by CDL in five blocks beside Jurong Lake Gardens. Preview 18 September 2026, booking 3 October.

launches.name: Thomson Reserve
launches.thesis: Upper Thomson MRT at the doorstep. Ai Tong within 1 km. 1,268 homes by UOL, Singapore Land and CapitaLand. Preview 3 October 2026.
